## Result

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the owning task and dependencies.

## Validation

List focused checks, source identity and material limits. Separate automated tests from native observation and owner acceptance.

## Privacy, licensing and continuity

- No real profiles, credentials, identifying paths or private evidence included.
- Existing copyright and third-party notices preserved; modified files identified.
- Relevant build/release instructions and docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md updated.
- Unrelated work, previous artifacts and user data preserved.
- Housekeeping: removed files; retained files/purpose; branch/worktree; preserved evidence; cleanup needing approval.
